senses.gloss:
उरु उरु, i. e. वृ + उ, adj.,
 I. f. उर्वी, Large, MBh. 1, 1222. Comparat. वरीयंस्, superl. वरिष्ठ, MBh. 14, 879. []
 II. f. उर्वी, the earth, Rām. 4, 44, 130.
 --Cf. εὐρύς, Ῥείη.

ऊरु ऊरु, perhaps akin to उरु, m. The thigh, Rām. 3, 52, 32. When the latter part of a comp. adj., the fem. ends in रु, or रू, e. g. वामोरु, i. e. वाम-, f. रू, Having beautiful thighs, MBh. 1, 1903; but रु (against the grammatical rule), MBh. 1, 2988.
 करभोपमोरु, i. e. करभ-उपम-ऊरु, f. रू, and करभोरु, i. e. करभ- f. रू, Having thighs like the proboscis of an elephant, Ragh. 6, 83; Śāk. d. 69.
 रम्भ-, f. रू, Having bambu-like thighs, Mālav. d. 45.
 वर-, f. रु, Having beautiful thighs, Rām. 3, 52, 53.
 --Comp.
ऊरु ऊरु, m. = और्व, Mālav. 71, d. 92. See कु-.
ऊरुज ऊरु-ज, adj. Born from the thigh, MBh. 1, 6820.
ऊरु- + संभव ऊरु- + संभव, adj., f. वा, produced from the thigh, Vikr. 8, 17.
